facts.label: Note
facts.value: 八旗通志 卷116 '坐落樹村西邉'; 日下旧闻考 j99:28a '樹村西有鑲黄旗護軍營房'. Today's 厢黄旗 lies 900 m W of 树村 (osm node 13399700269): fits. Layout typical of S02 p.56 (walled square, rows of south-facing houses, 关帝庙 inside the N gate, HQ at the crossing, school, armoury, drill field with a 3-bay 箭亭 per camp-01): description of the 1920s-30s, B.
